subject: Anthem Health: private-hosting discovery & network plan
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
To: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@anthemhealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya@anthemhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Diego Fernandez <diego_fernandez@redwood.ai>

Subject: Anthem Health discovery — private hosting recap + initial asks

Hi Rajiv / Priya,

Great to meet this morning — thanks for taking the time. Recapping the important points so we have a single source of truth and clear next steps.

Quick summary of the pain and goals you described:
- Regulatory driver: certain workloads (PHI-linked inference) must remain within EU residency and be logically air-gapped from public internet for processing windows.
- Networking constraint: no direct outbound internet egress from the isolated environment; only whitelisted private endpoints/proxy allowed.
- Storage rules: customers cannot upload unencrypted artifacts to third-party S3-like buckets; encryption with customer-managed KMS/HSM required.
- Audit & controls: long-term audit logs, evidence for quarterly audits, and support for enterprise key rotation policies.
- Ops requirement: ability to run on-prem or in your VPC with a private control plane and optional air-gap deployment for batch windows.

What Redwood can offer (high level):
- Private deployment package (VPC connector or on-prem appliance) with customer KMS integration and audit log streaming.
- Egress-locking support: routes via a customer-controlled NAT/proxy and IP allowlist for Redwood management/control-plane egress.
- Configurable data residency pinning and ability to restrict model artifact staging to your controlled buckets.

Open technical clarifications we need from your side:
1) Can you confirm whether the entire inference path must be fully air-gapped, or only model staging and admin/control operations?
2) Do you have an existing proxy/gateway we can use for outbound management traffic, or will Redwood need a managed jumpbox?
3) Which KMS provider and HSM SKU (if any) are preferred?
4) Expected QPS/P95 latency SLOs for the initial pilot (helpful for sizing): rough numbers are fine.

Proposed immediate next steps (aiming for a technical deep-dive within 5 business days):
- Anthem to share network diagram and firewall rules (we attached a template to make this easy). [Attachment: network_requirements_template.pdf (PDF, 45KB)]
- Anthem to return completed security questionnaire (to speed procurement).
- Redwood to schedule a 60-min technical deep-dive with our solutions engineering and runtime leads (cc'd: Marissa and Diego).

Attachments included: network_requirements_template.pdf, Redwood private deploy one-pager.

If the above looks right, Rajiv / Priya — can you share the network diagram and the attendee list for the deep-dive?

Thanks,

Olga Petrov

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv@anthemhealth.com>

Subject: Re: Anthem Health discovery — private hosting recap + initial asks

Thanks Olga — this is a helpful recap. A few clarifications on our end: 

- Scope of air-gap: primary requirement is that inference for PHI-labeled models runs within an environment that has no public internet access during scheduled processing windows. Admin/control traffic can be brokered through a narrow, auditable management channel with mutual TLS.
- Proxy/gateway: we do have an in-house outbound proxy (apex-proxy-01) that we can use; it supports mTLS and static IPs.
- KMS/HSM: we use AWS KMS with CloudHSM for key custody today; rotation policies are enforced via IAM roles. We can provide the key origin details.
- Sizing: pilot expected to be ~50 qps with P95 target of ~150ms; eventual ramp to 500 qps over 3 months.

I've attached our updated security questionnaire and a very high level network sketch.

Attendees for the deep-dive: myself, Priya (security), and our infra lead (Tomas Verma, tomas@anthemhealth.com). Tomas will be the technical authority on firewall and proxy rules.

We should aim for next Tuesday afternoon (US PST) for the deep-dive — available windows: 1–3pm PST.

[Attachment: security_questionnaire_v2.docx (DOCX, 210KB)]
[Attachment: anthem-network-sketch.png (PNG, 85KB)]

—Rajiv
